title: Chapter 21: Party of More Than One?
html:
The small room had a leaking ceiling and barred windows. Damp had seeped into the walls, filling the air with the sour smell of mold. Chen Ge examined the wooden boards over the windows and noticed that they looked much newer than the rest of the room.

This is just an ordinary guest room.The ruined furniture had been cleared away, leaving the room almost completely bare.Then again, years have passed. Even if there was evidence here once, most of it would be long gone.

Chen Ge returned to the corridor. Most of the rooms were empty, while discarded furniture, packaging, and other rubbish made the passage difficult to navigate.

People leave traces of their lives in what they throw away. Maybe some of this can tell me who has been using the third floor.

With that thought in mind, Chen Ge searched through the abandoned clutter despite the smell. After nearly an hour, he finally found something unusual.

Dolls? I haven’t seen any children in the building. Who did these belong to?By the time he finished searching, Chen Ge had found four rag dolls. Buried among so much junk, they might have escaped his notice if he had not studied toy design.

The dolls had clearly been there for years. Their fabric was stained, patches of mold had spread across them, and the stuffing had become brittle with age.

On closer inspection, Chen Ge realized that although the four dolls were different designs, they had all been made by the same manufacturer.

Could former tenants have left them here?He quickly dismissed the idea.Families with children probably didn’t move into this place often, and four dolls from the same manufacturer seemed too deliberate to be random. Their designs were old as well—several years out of date, at least.

Toy lines changed quickly. Before taking over the Haunted House, Chen Ge had worked for a toy company, so he knew enough to recognize older designs.

If these weren’t left by the newer tenants, then maybe they belonged to the family who originally ran Fu An Apartments,Chen Ge thought.The owner had two daughters. If I’m right, these dolls may have belonged to them.

But that raised another question.If the building was badly damaged, how did all four dolls survive?

Was it luck, or did someone deliberately put them somewhere protected?Chen Ge felt as though he had finally found a promising thread.Someone cared enough about these dolls to keep them safe. If that person was connected to the old case, why were the dolls so important?

The zipper on the back of the first doll had rusted shut, so Chen Ge carefully opened the old seam. Hidden among the stuffing was a card small enough to fit in his palm—a love letter. The earnest gesture made him cringe a little on the sender’s behalf.A love letter hidden inside a doll? That is unbelievably cheesy.

Whoever had written it seemed shy and reserved, unable to confess directly and hoping the recipient would eventually discover the message inside the gift.

Curiosity got the better of Chen Ge. He checked two more dolls and found a card inside each one, both carrying messages similar to the first.

The fourth doll, however, was different. A chill went through him when he opened it.

Instead of a love letter, it contained torn scraps of paper. Put together, they formed a single furious message: GO TO HELL!

Somewhere along the way, affection had turned into hatred. Chen Ge had no idea what had happened between the two.

If these were left by someone connected to the case, they could be important evidence.He slipped several scraps of paper into his pocket. Just as he prepared to search farther down the corridor, the light near the stairwell suddenly came on.

Damn. Someone’s coming.Chen Ge immediately extinguished his phone light, gathered the dolls, and slipped into the nearest guest room. He stayed behind the door and watched through the narrow gap beside the frame.

Footsteps drew closer, followed by the voices of a man and a woman coming up the stairs.

“We have to move that thing soon. We can’t keep putting it off.”

“The new tenant already came up to the third floor once. Luckily, he turned back at the stairs before he saw me.”

“I know. Too many new people have been coming around lately. We need to deal with it tonight.”

“Agreed.”

“Tell the others to get ready. We’ll move it tonight and hide it somewhere in the hills.”

One of them carried an old-fashioned oil lamp. In its dim light, Chen Ge recognized the landlord and the woman from the first floor.

Why are the two of them coming up here in the middle of the night?

Chen Ge pressed himself deeper into the shadows, careful not to be seen.

Not long afterward, the tattooed man and the heavyset man also came upstairs. They wore dark clothing and carried sacks and assorted tools.

What are they planning?

The small group gathered in the corridor, already in the middle of an argument.

The heavyset man trailed behind the others with his head lowered. “Do we really have to do this? The moment we touch anything, we leave evidence behind. How are we supposed to explain that later?”

“And you think the situation is easy to explain now?” The landlord glared at him. “Stop complaining and move.”

“I still think we should call the police.” The heavyset man refused to budge.

The tattooed man seized him by the collar. “Have you lost your mind? If the police investigate this place, they’ll start looking into all of us. Your old case, our occupation of the property—everything comes out.”

“Honey, calm down.” The woman rested a hand on the tattooed man’s arm. “We’re already in this together. Turning on one another won’t help.”

“None of us can afford police attention, and it took us long enough to find a place where we could lie low.” The landlord shoved a tool toward the heavyset man. “Quit hesitating and get started.”

“Me?” The heavyset man immediately went pale. Sweat gathered on his forehead as he reluctantly stepped forward.

The longer Chen Ge watched, the more uneasy he became.What are they trying to uncover?

The heavyset man went to the far end of the corridor. He cleared aside a mound of rubbish and pulled back a curtain that had been hidden behind it.

Behind the curtain was a section of reinforced cement—and within it, the outline of human remains.
